findings.title: Primary metric is a revenue proxy
findings.evidence: The key metric follows revenue, not the cost of waste and lost sales.
findings.why: Revenue moves with prices and promotions, which hides the effect of the forecast.
findings.fix: Measure waste plus lost sales in money per store-day.
